backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual operating_cash_flow and capex are known by SEC filed date (<= signal date) and matched on the same fiscal-year period end; total assets uses the latest filed value. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: SEC companyfacts filed date and period end

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: PIT SEC Companyfacts free-cash-flow coverage of capex, paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation, may identify self-funding quality leaders better than broad accruals or asset-growth quality.
interpretation: The free-cash-flow capex coverage source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high). It is not retained or promoted.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT capex/cash-flow evidence or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep FCF/assets, OCF/capex, capex/assets, fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping FCF/assets, OCF/capex, capex/assets, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT capex/cash-flow evidence or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep FCF/assets, OCF/capex, capex/assets, fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.5814; aggregate PnL delta $+17,584.58; max drawdown drift +0.0294; 332 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The free-cash-flow capex coverage source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high). It is not retained or promoted.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: production-universe names whose latest annual operating cash flow comfortably funds capex, and that show liquid SPY-relative price confirmation, may represent self-funding quality leadership rather than capex-starved or debt-funded momentum.

2_history_check.exp-20260529-003: Rejected low-capex-intensity support inside the accepted fundamental-growth sleeve. This run is not capex/revenue support; it requires operating cash flow to cover capex and measures a standalone default-off candidate source.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-020/025/027: Accruals, TTM same-period accruals, and TTM cash-flow acceleration were rejected or drawdown-failing. Their records explicitly named capex/free-cash-flow coverage as a materially different next PIT discriminator.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-002/003/006: Low asset growth, cash-backed low asset growth, and industry-relative asset growth all improved aggregate metrics but failed window/drawdown/comparator gates. This run does not sweep asset growth thresholds.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and the accepted compression and distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Capex coverage is a distinct PIT free Companyfacts quality field suggested by the prior accruals/asset-growth failures; it should favor self-funding leaders, but capex coverage may be sparse and annual quality fields have recently been crowded and drawdown-prone.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual operating-cash-flow/capex on a matching fiscal year end, missing assets, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual free-cash-flow/capex coverage quality gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
